layers.note: Large clumps on rocky hillsides of desert grassland, chaparral and oak and pinyon-juniper woodland.

moisture.note: Shallow, rocky soils; FEIS: dry sites about 400 mm of rain a year, falling in winter and summer.

heat_load.note: FEIS: most important on moderate to steep north-facing slopes; Kearney and Peebles: usually in exposed situations on mountainsides.

elevation_m.note: 900 to 1,900 m (Flora of North America); 3,000 to 6,500 feet in Arizona (FEIS; Kearney and Peebles). The bajada lies below its usual range, at its lowest edge.

shade_tolerance.note: Open ground to the light shade of oaks and junipers.

coldest_c.note: Across its range, coldest-month means from about 1 to 11.5 °C; gone below −3 °C and above 13.5 °C.

hard_freeze_c.note: Across its range, lows to about −18 °C borne, gone where the year's coldest night falls below about −24 °C.

warmest_c.note: Across its range, warmest-month means from about 22 to 31.5 °C; gone below 19 °C, where summers are too short, and above 33.5 °C.

degree_days_0.note: About 3,600 to 7,800 degree-days above 0 °C, none below 2,800.

degree_days_5.note: About 2,200 to 6,000 degree-days above 5 °C, none below 1,500.

moisture_index.note: A moisture index from about 0.14 to 0.6, gone by 0.1 and above 0.8.

summer_rain.note: Needs the monsoon's summer rain: from about 0.35 of the year's precipitation in summer, gone below 0.25; up to about 0.65, gone by 0.75.

provenance.notes: Authored for the Saguaro desert scene (the west bajada of Saguaro National Park's Tucson Mountain District, about 750 m, 32.25 N 111.17 W) from general knowledge of the species and the ranges, habitats and elevations in the sources read for its spec (2026-10-19). Beargrass (sacahuista) grows from central Arizona to western New Mexico and northern Mexico (Flora of North America; FEIS). Each climate range brackets the climate of that range, an approximate envelope read from these descriptions, not fitted to occurrence records; every full range holds the bajada's climate (coldest month about 11 °C, warmest about 31 °C, about 7,600 degree-days above 0 °C, coldest night about −4 °C, moisture index about 0.15, about half the year's rain in summer).
